title: Сharitable edition of "Russian Folk Tales"
content: We are pleased to announce the festive charitable edition of "Russian Folk Tales" prepared within the framework of the project “Kindness Tales” by RB Partners jointly with Merrill Lynch, Glencore, Infowatch, Webcontrol, Visual Comfort Gallery, Khann, Asadov and MBS. The funds raised from publication of this book will be transferred to the Center of Humanitarian Programs for the treatment of severely ill children (www.cgp.ru). It is great that a number of project participants is increasing year by year!

title: RB Partners participated in the GLOBALSCOPE international investment conference in Paris on April 17th, 2019
content: In 1987, a group of consultants in corporate finance and business consulting merged to support clients in cross-border transactions. After 30 years, Globalscope has got 10,000 completed transactions worldwide and 55 members in 48 countries, including RB ASIA in Uzbekistan. The Globalscope spring conference was held on April 10-13 in Paris, France. At the conference, it was announced that Globalscope completed 77 transactions amounting to € 1,628 million during 4Q 2018 and 1Q 2019, which was an exceptional result. In addition, Doniyor Islamov, Managing Director of RB ASIA, made a presentation on New Investment Horizons in Uzbekistan. The presentation aroused a great interest on the part of Globascope participants, and many of them offered projects with intent for cooperation in Uzbekistan. The above was followed by industry-specific meetings in consumer, telecommunication, financial, industrial and service sectors. At those meetings, investment opportunities in each of the sectors were presented. During the gala dinner at the Chateau de Versailles, the Globalscope companies with the best results were awarded prizes. Paramax (USA) and CatCap (Germany) were honored with the top position, as each of the companies completed 8 transactions during Q4 2018 and Q1 2019. Finally, it was announced that the next Globalscope conference would be held in New Delhi (India) in the fall of 2019 and would be organized by RCS Advisors.
